description: SonicWall reseller in India for TZ and NSa firewalls, Capture Client and secure remote access, with GST invoice. Send your site details for a written quote.
intro:
SonicWall has been making firewalls for a long time, and its range is built around a simple idea: put a capable security appliance in every office, from a five-person branch to a head office, and let the same subscriptions protect all of them. It is well known for the TZ series for small and branch offices, the NSa series for mid-sized networks, and a set of remote-access and endpoint products around them.

Buyers in India are often small and mid-sized organisations: retail chains with shops that need a secure link to head office, CA and law firms, schools, hospitals, hotels and factories with a modest IT team. SonicWall also has a long history with managed service providers, who value that the product is straightforward to deploy at many customer locations. The appeal is a dependable perimeter without a complicated platform to learn.

TechZoid is a SonicWall reseller. We do not list SonicWall products or prices in our online catalogue; each requirement is quoted on request. Tell us the sites and users you need to protect, and we will send a written quotation for the appliance, the security subscriptions and support. The quotation fixes the price, and orders carry a GST invoice. See our wider [firewall and network security](/firewall-security) range, or [send an enquiry](/enquiry) directly.

lines.name: TZ series firewalls
lines.use: Compact firewalls for small offices and branches, including models with built-in wireless, covering VPN, content filtering and intrusion prevention.

lines.name: NSa series firewalls
lines.use: Higher-capacity firewalls for mid-sized networks and campuses where more users and more inspected traffic are expected.

lines.name: SonicWave access points
lines.use: Wi-Fi access points designed to be managed alongside the firewall, for offices that want wireless under the same policy.

lines.name: Capture Client
lines.use: Endpoint protection for laptops and servers that can work with the firewall, for firms that want to extend protection past the network edge.

lines.name: Secure Mobile Access (SMA)
lines.use: Remote access for staff working from home or on the road, giving secure entry to internal applications.

lines.name: SonicWall email security
lines.use: Filtering for spam, phishing and malicious attachments, available for organisations that want an additional layer for their mail.

choose:
A SonicWall purchase usually comes down to model size and which security services to switch on. Begin by listing your sites. For each, note the internet speed, the number of people, and how many will connect through VPN. Then ask us to match the model to the throughput available with threat prevention enabled, because performance with those features on is lower than the plain firewall figure.

Branch offices and small businesses normally fit the TZ range, while a head office with several hundred users, heavy remote access or a busy server room is the territory of the NSa range. If staff work from home, decide whether they will use the firewall's built-in VPN or a dedicated remote access product, since that changes the sizing. Wireless is the other decision, either a firewall with built-in Wi-Fi or separate access points that cover more floor area. If you are still choosing a brand, compare with the [Fortinet](/brands/fortinet) and [Cisco](/brands/cisco) hubs, and look at the [India firewall comparison](/blog/top-firewall-brands-india-fortinet-sophos-sonicwall-cisco).
buying:
SonicWall is sold as an appliance with security services layered over it. The hardware is bought once, while the threat-prevention and support services are tied to a term, which is usually one or three years. The firewall remains usable if services lapse, but threat feeds and support entitlements stop, so renewal matters. SonicWall has offered its services as bundles as well as separate items, so ask us to price both when you are not sure.

When you order, the appliance must be registered against your organisation so that services can be activated. We can help with that registration and with activation so that the licences are tied to the right company account rather than an individual. Keep that account with a shared mailbox, not a personal address, because renewal reminders and support access depend on it.

Here is what we need to quote:

- Sites, with users and devices at each
- Internet link speeds and number of providers
- VPN users and any home-working staff
- Whether you need a failover pair
- Wi-Fi requirements, built-in or separate access points
- The existing firewall, if you are replacing one
- Subscription term wanted

Quotations are written, and the quoted figures, not figures seen elsewhere, fix the price. Orders are invoiced with GST, which GST-registered buyers can usually claim as input credit, and we can work to your purchase order. For design review or rollout help, our [cybersecurity service](/services/cybersecurity) can be engaged under a separately agreed scope.

faqs.question: What does a SonicWall firewall cost in India?
faqs.answer: There is no fixed answer because the model, services bundle and term all change the total. TechZoid does not publish SonicWall prices. Send us your sites, users and link speeds and we will provide a written quotation for the appliance, subscriptions and support, which is the price you can rely on.

faqs.question: Do SonicWall security services need yearly renewal?
faqs.answer: They are sold for a fixed term, commonly one or three years, and need renewing to keep threat updates and support active. The appliance keeps working without them, but it is then protected less well. We can quote renewals before expiry and track the date for you if you wish.

faqs.question: Can TechZoid help set up the firewall?
faqs.answer: We can help with registration, activation of services and the rollout plan, and our cybersecurity team can be engaged for deployment and policy review as a scoped service. Hardware and product support come through SonicWall's entitlement purchased with the unit. Your quotation will set out the scope.

faqs.question: What should I send for a SonicWall quotation?
faqs.answer: Please send your number of sites, users per site, internet speeds, remote workers, whether you want failover or Wi-Fi, and what firewall you use now. Mention any need for endpoint or email protection and the term you prefer. With that, we can match a model properly.

faqs.question: Is it easy to replace another firewall with SonicWall?
faqs.answer: It is routine, but rules, NAT entries and VPN settings usually need to be recreated and tested rather than imported directly. Plan a short change window and keep the old unit available for rollback. Tell us what you run today so we can reflect that in the quotation.

faqs.question: Do you provide a GST invoice and work to purchase orders?
faqs.answer: Yes. We invoice every order with GST and can work to your purchase order, including one order combining SonicWall with items from other brands. GST-registered buyers can usually claim input credit. Send your billing details with the enquiry and we will prepare the paperwork.
